# vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp

## Overview

[`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L1-L22) registers the `sparse_resources.shader_intrinsics` branch, and directly delegates case construction to sampled-image and storage-image sparse-intrinsic implementations ([`vktSparseResourcesTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesTests.cpp#L62), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L24-L25)). The branch tests SPIR-V sparse image operations by generating images with alternating resident/nonresident mip levels, copying known input data into resident memory, executing sparse image operations, and comparing both texel output and reported residency ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp#L770-L913), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp#L1160-L1238)).

## Role

Registration file plus implementation hub. The top-level file registers direct children by combining image type and SPIR-V sparse operation names, while the inspected helper files implement sampled-image rendering paths, storage-image compute paths, shared sparse image setup, and verification ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L51-L160), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp#L135-L405), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp#L50-L415), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp#L574-L1238)).

## Test Families

### 2d_sparse_fetch — `OpImageSparseFetch` on 2D sampled images

This child is generated by combining `IMAGE_TYPE_2D` with the `_sparse_fetch` suffix and constructing `SparseCaseOpImageSparseFetch` cases from the storage helper class ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L73-L84), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L88-L100)). `OpImageSparseFetch` emits `Lod` plus optional `Nontemporal` operands and uses a sampled-image descriptor path ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp#L417-L438), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp#L753-L775)).

### 2d_array_sparse_fetch — `OpImageSparseFetch` on 2D-array sampled images

This child has the same operation as `2d_sparse_fetch` but uses array image sizes such as `512x256x6` and `128x128x8` from the 2D-array parameter row ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L59-L61), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L138-L151)).

### 3d_sparse_fetch — `OpImageSparseFetch` on 3D sampled images

This child is allowed for 3D images because fetch only skips cube and cube-array image types in the registration loop ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L120-L126)).

### 2d_sparse_read — `OpImageSparseRead` on 2D storage images

This child is generated by combining `IMAGE_TYPE_2D` with `_sparse_read` and constructing `SparseCaseOpImageSparseRead` cases ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L73-L84), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L95-L108)). `OpImageSparseRead` uses a storage-image descriptor path and emits the optional operand directly ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp#L441-L463), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp#L777-L799)).

### 2d_array_sparse_read — `OpImageSparseRead` on 2D-array storage images

This child uses the same storage-image read operation with 2D-array sizes and formats from the image-parameter table ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L59-L61), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp#L531-L572)).

### cube_sparse_read — `OpImageSparseRead` on cube storage images

This child is registered because the skip rules do not exclude cube images for `SPARSE_READ` ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L120-L136)). Runtime enables cube-compatible image creation for cube and cube-array types ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp#L600-L603)).

### cube_array_sparse_read — `OpImageSparseRead` on cube-array storage images

This child is registered for the same reason as `cube_sparse_read`, using the cube-array row in the image-parameter table ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L65-L67), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L120-L136)).

### 3d_sparse_read — `OpImageSparseRead` on 3D storage images

This child is registered because `SPARSE_READ` has no image-type skip in the switch and therefore includes 3D images ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L68-L71), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L120-L136)).

### 2d_sparse_sample_explicit_lod — `OpImageSparseSampleExplicitLod` on 2D sampled images

This child is generated from `_sparse_sample_explicit_lod` and implemented by `SparseCaseOpImageSparseSampleExplicitLod`, which emits `OpImageSparseSampleExplicitLod` with `Lod` and optional `Nontemporal` operands ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L73-L84), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp#L407-L420)).

### 2d_array_sparse_sample_explicit_lod — `OpImageSparseSampleExplicitLod` on 2D-array sampled images

This child uses the same sampled explicit-LOD operation but with 2D-array image sizes and layered rendering when array layers are present ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L59-L61), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp#L164-L200)).

### 2d_sparse_sample_implicit_lod — `OpImageSparseSampleImplicitLod` on 2D sampled images

This child is implemented by `SparseCaseOpImageSparseSampleImplicitLod`, which emits `OpImageSparseSampleImplicitLod` from the sampled helper path ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.hpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.hpp#L81-L109), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp#L422-L436)).

### 2d_array_sparse_sample_implicit_lod — `OpImageSparseSampleImplicitLod` on 2D-array sampled images

This child combines the implicit-LOD sampled operation with 2D-array image parameters; sampled operations skip cube, cube-array, and 3D image types in the registration loop ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L127-L133)).

### 2d_sparse_gather — `OpImageSparseGather` on 2D sampled images

This child is implemented by `SparseCaseOpImageSparseGather`, which issues four `OpImageSparseGather` operations and builds a primary texel plus residency code for validation ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.hpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.hpp#L111-L124), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp#L438-L511)).

### 2d_array_sparse_gather — `OpImageSparseGather` on 2D-array sampled images

This child uses the same gather helper with 2D-array coordinates; gather is skipped for cube, cube-array, and 3D image types by the same registration switch as sampled operations ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L127-L133), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp#L458-L482)).

## Parameter Dimensions

| Dimension | Observed values / source |
|---|---|
| Sparse functions | `_sparse_fetch`, `_sparse_read`, `_sparse_sample_explicit_lod`, `_sparse_sample_implicit_lod`, and `_sparse_gather` map to five `SpirVFunction` values and constructor functions ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.hpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.hpp#L79-L87), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L73-L84)). |
| Image types | The parameter table includes 2D, 2D array, cube, cube array, and 3D, with function-specific skip rules limiting fetch and sampled/gather combinations ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L55-L71), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L119-L136)). |
| Image sizes | Each image type lists four sizes; alignment checks skip odd-size cases for formats that require larger image-size alignment ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L55-L71), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L110-L117)). |
| Operands | Every generated size creates a default operand case, and the last size additionally creates a `_nontemporal` case requiring Vulkan 1.3 or higher ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L143-L151), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.hpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.hpp#L131-L132)). |

## Support / Feature Requirements

All shader-intrinsic cases require `shaderResourceResidency`, image-size support, sparse support for the image type, and Vulkan 1.3 for `Nontemporal` operand variants ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.hpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.hpp#L116-L133)). Runtime checks sparse support for the concrete image format, requires `VK_EXT_shader_image_atomic_int64` and related int64 sparse-image atomic features for R64 formats, creates sparse-binding plus graphics or compute queues depending on the operation class, and rejects sparse images whose memory requirements exceed `sparseAddressSpaceSize` ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp#L549-L572), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp#L626-L733)). Sampled cases additionally require sampled-image and color-attachment format support, while storage cases require storage-image support for the format or storage-compatible planes ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp#L561-L590), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp#L486-L519)).

## Verification Methods

The shared base binds only even-indexed sparse mip levels as resident and marks odd-indexed mip levels as nonresident in `residencyReferenceData`; mip tails are bound and marked resident ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp#L723-L845)). It fills a reference buffer, copies it into the sparse image, records either graphics sampled operations or compute storage operations, copies texel and residency output images back to buffers, and compares residency output exactly against `MEMORY_BLOCK_BOUND_VALUE` / `MEMORY_BLOCK_NOT_BOUND_VALUE` expectations ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp#L986-L1155), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp#L1160-L1188)). Texel verification compares resident mips against reference bytes, optionally checks strict nonresident mips for zero, and compares mip-tail data against reference bytes ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp#L1189-L1238)).

## Test Principles Observed

- The direct children are operation-by-image-type groups; deeper generated cases vary format, image size, and optional operand ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L88-L157)).
- Sampled operations use graphics rendering to color attachments, while storage/fetch/read operations use compute dispatch and storage images ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp#L627-L935), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp#L531-L751)).
- Verification checks both what texels were returned and what residency status the sparse intrinsic reported ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp#L379-L399), [`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp#L377-L398)).

## Notes / Uncertainties

- `vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsSampled.cpp`, `vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsStorage.cpp`, and `vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsicsBase.cpp` were inspected as directly related helpers, but they do not register independent top-level CTS groups; no separate Level-3 pages were created for them in this scope ([`vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/sparse_resources/vktSparseResourcesShaderIntrinsics.cpp#L44-L160)).
